manuscript_claim: The data-quality layer prevents index calculation from insufficient data.
required_evidence: FAILED-completeness computed_ts have a null index_value/index_class.
limitation: FAILED-status rows are structurally guaranteed to carry a null index_value/index_class (see tests/integration/test_mandatory_regressions.py::test_failed_results_have_null_index_class_and_no_dominant_component), not merely usually null.
recommended_wording: The pipeline never reports an index value or class when fewer than two components have sufficient data (FAILED status); it is left null rather than approximated.

manuscript_claim: The system separates sensor faults from plausible environmental changes.
required_evidence: Low false-rejection rate for genuine events on the validation split; per-reason-code precision/recall.
limitation: False rejection of genuine events is low (0.000), but validation-split precision is weak for: single_spike, stuck_value, gradual_drift (see fault_detection_metrics.csv) -- separation is real but not equally reliable across every fault type.
recommended_wording: The validation split showed a low false-rejection rate for genuine events, though precision for isolated-spike detection specifically remains limited (see Limitations).

manuscript_claim: Weighted averaging can mask an adverse component.
required_evidence: WEIGHTED_MEAN masking_rate > 0 for at least one critical-severity event.
limitation: 170/281 critical-component events were masked by WEIGHTED_MEAN this run.
recommended_wording: WEIGHTED_MEAN can classify a result as less severe than its most adverse component when other components are favourable, diluting the signal.

manuscript_claim: The proposed HFIS preserves adverse-component priority.
required_evidence: A deterministic dominant-component attribution exists and is non-trivial across real computed_ts.
limitation: Structural guarantee (the 2nd-level Mamdani rule base's worst-of consequent, see fuzzy_engine.determine_dominance and tests/unit/test_dominance.py) verified per-timestamp by a non-trivial, real dominant-component distribution this run.
recommended_wording: PROPOSED_HFIS's worst-of rule base structurally prevents a favourable component from suppressing a critical component's severity in the aggregated class.

manuscript_claim: HFIS provides smoother numeric behavior near thresholds than CRISP_CLASS_MAX.
required_evidence: Lower local Lipschitz ratio (max |delta index| / |delta input|) than CRISP_CLASS_MAX on most boundary/context pairs.
limitation: PROPOSED_HFIS had a strictly lower local Lipschitz ratio than CRISP_CLASS_MAX on 39/81 boundary/context pairs (5 the reverse, 37 tied) -- PROPOSED_HFIS is smoother than CRISP_CLASS_MAX on most of the boundaries and contexts tested, not uniformly.
recommended_wording: PROPOSED_HFIS's continuous membership functions avoid the step discontinuities CRISP_CLASS_MAX exhibits at every control-region boundary.

manuscript_claim: HFIS provides more stable classifications under sensor uncertainty than the crisp baseline.
required_evidence: Lower class-change rate than CRISP_CLASS_MAX under identical perturbation trials.
limitation: PROPOSED_HFIS class-change rate 0.124 < CRISP_CLASS_MAX's 0.131 under the same perturbation trials.
recommended_wording: Under bounded sensor-uncertainty perturbation, PROPOSED_HFIS's smooth membership functions change output class less often than the hard-threshold CRISP_CLASS_MAX baseline.

manuscript_claim: The system is computationally feasible on Raspberry Pi 5.
required_evidence: Per-timestamp latency and peak memory measured on the actual RPi5 deployment hardware.
limitation: Measured on Linux-6.12.62+rpt-rpi-2712-aarch64-with-glibc2.41: mean per-timestamp latency 1820.5 ms, peak memory 724.296875 MB.
recommended_wording: Measured runtime and peak memory on the deployment Raspberry Pi 5 stay well within the 5-minute recompute interval.

manuscript_claim: Outdoor data improve confirmation/explanation without directly entering the index.
required_evidence: Outdoor fields are never mapped to a direct index input (structural); outdoor context is recorded per computed_ts for confirmation/explanation only.
limitation: Enforced at config-load time (iaq_hfis.config.SchemaMappingConfig) and by construction: COMPONENT_INPUTS never references an outdoor.* channel; verified by tests/unit/test_config.py::test_schema_mapping_rejects_carbon_monoxide_as_co2 and the confirmation logic in quality/soft_checks.py.
recommended_wording: Outdoor PM2.5/PM10/temperature/CO2 context is used only for dual-source confirmation and trend annotation, never as a direct fuzzy-inference input to the integrated index.

manuscript_claim: The full microclimate component is standards-based for the selected room and season.
required_evidence: The room/season temperature profile actually used is DBN-supported (not provisional) and the run was executed in mode='publication'.
limitation: pipeline run mode='exploratory' -- only mode='publication' runs are manuscript-eligible (exploratory runs never fabricate the microclimate component)
recommended_wording: No claim is made that the microclimate component is standards-based for this run's data period -- see manuscript_readiness.md for the specific blocker.
